(PORT=3917 node .output/server/index.mjs > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
B=http://localhost:3917
echo "--- quote"; curl -s -XPOST $B/api/cart/quote -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"notebook","qty":2},{"slug":"pencil","qty":3}],"code":"SAVE10"}'; echo
echo "--- order"; R=$(curl -s -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"notebook","qty":2},{"slug":"pencil","qty":3}],"code":"SAVE10"}'); echo $R
ID=$(echo $R | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0)).id')
echo "--- get"; curl -s $B/api/orders/$ID; echo
echo "--- get 404"; curl -s -w ' %{http_code}' $B/api/orders/nope; echo
echo "--- bad slug"; curl -s -w ' %{http_code}' -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"nope","qty":1}]}'; echo
echo "--- bad qty"; curl -s -w ' %{http_code}' -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[{"slug":"pencil","qty":0}]}'; echo
echo "--- empty"; curl -s -w ' %{http_code}' -XPOST $B/api/orders -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"lines":[]}'; echo
echo "--- page"; curl -s $B/orders/$ID | grep -oE '<li class="order-line">.{0,200}|id="order-total">[^<]*' | head; echo
echo "--- page 404-ish"; curl -s $B/orders/nope | grep -oE 'id="order-error"[^<]*' ; echo
pkill -f "node .output/server/index.mjs"; true
